text: I find myself in an environment that resonates with curiosity and the pursuit of knowledge. The large glass doors and the visible countdown timer suggest anticipation and preparation, as if something about to unfold demands my attention. As I move deeper, vibrant graphics announcing 'R+D' greet me, and I sense the energy of innovation and experimentation. The interplay between digital screens and physical displays makes me reflect on the nature of learning and human interaction with technology. I feel stimulated, yet slightly disoriented by the angles and intensity of the visuals, as if invited to question not only what I see but how I see it.
